component.name: Mark Shot
component.summary: Native screenshot, annotation and recording tool
原生截图、标注与录屏工具

description.p: Mark Shot captures and annotates screenshots on Wayland and X11. It includes scrolling capture, pinned images, local OCR, translation, QR and barcode recognition, and screen recording.
Mark Shot 支持 Wayland 与 X11 截图、图像标注、滚动截图、置顶贴图、本地文字识别、翻译、二维码与条形码识别，以及屏幕录制。
